title: Sep-Latent: Separator Tokens as Natural Compression Anchors for Implicit Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in complex reasoning through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT), but the associated computational overhead and token verbosity remain significant barriers to efficiency. While implicit reasoning in continuous latent spaces offers a promising alternative, existing methods like Coconut and CODI often rely on fixed-length latent sequences and suffer from representational collapse. In this paper, we propose Sep-Latent, an adaptive implicit reasoning framework that utilizes separator tokens as structural semantic anchors. By introducing an Attention-Decay mechanism, we force the model to aggregate and compress reasoning logic into these anchors during training. We then align explicit and implicit pathways through multi-level distillation across all layers to ensure logical consistency. Crucially, Sep-Latent enables dynamic reasoning depth by adaptively terminating the latent think

translated_title: Sep-Latent：将分隔符标记作为隐式推理的天然压缩锚点
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过显式的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）在复杂推理中取得了显著成功，但由此带来的计算开销和标记冗余仍然是效率提升的重大障碍。虽然连续潜在空间中的隐式推理提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但现有方法（如Coconut和CODI）通常依赖固定长度的潜在序列，并存在表示坍缩的问题。在本文中，我们提出了Sep-Latent，这是一种自适应隐式推理框架，它利用分隔符标记作为结构化的语义锚点。通过引入注意力衰减机制，我们迫使模型在训练过程中将推理逻辑聚合和压缩到这些锚点中。随后，我们通过跨所有层级的多层级蒸馏来对齐显式与隐式路径，以确保逻辑一致性。至关重要的是，Sep-Latent通过自适应地终止潜在思考过程，实现了动态推理深度……
tldr: 本文提出Sep-Latent框架，将分隔符标记作为语义压缩锚点，结合注意力衰减机制与多层级蒸馏实现动态深度的隐式推理，从而在保持逻辑一致性的同时显著降低显式思维链的计算开销。
en_tdlr: Sep-Latent leverages separator tokens as structural compression anchors with an attention-decay mechanism and multi-level distillation to enable adaptive-depth implicit reasoning, significantly reducing the computational overhead of explicit Chain-of-Thought while preserving logical consistency.
